theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_carrier_graph_symmDiff
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (M S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (R s : ℝ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), s ≤ R → Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' S) ∩ ball 0 R = graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ ball 0 R → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (M ∩ ball ξ s) (S ∩ ball ξ s)) = 0 → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ s → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' M) ∩ ball 0 ρ) (graphOver u {x | x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) ρ ∧ ‖graphPoint x (u x)‖ < ρ})) = 0
